lina: running into onboarding pain: our Go sample app for function-calling + json_mode is failing customers with zod/schema errors. reproducer in examples/go/json-fn-sample.
noah: what kind of error?
lina: model sometimes emits function_call.arguments as a JSON string literal (escaped) and other times as an object. our Go helper unmarshals into map[string]any but it fails when arguments is a string: "json: cannot unmarshal string into Go value of type map[string]interface{}".
noah: this sounds like parity again. we normalize in Python/TS but Go helper doesn't attempt layered parsing.
tess: also noticed SDK retry behavior: the Go client retries on 401/429 by default; if the function call triggered a downstream side effect, the webhook got the payload twice. customer saw duplicate invoice entries.
lina: minimal repro: call client.Chat.Create with json_mode true and functions defined, endpoint returns 401 the first time then 200, SDK retries and webhooks get two posts.
noah: two separate issues: 1) parsing/normalizing function_call.arguments (handle string vs object, and double-encoded JSON), 2) retry semantics for side-effecting calls.
tess: Proposed fix for Go SDK: implement NormalizeFunctionArgs(raw []byte) (map[string]any, error) that attempts: single json.Unmarshal to map, if that fails and raw is string, unquote and unmarshal again, try repeated unquoting up to 2 times, then return helpful error. Also add a strictParse flag in client config so users can opt into error-on-string behavior.
noah: Add unit tests: nested arrays, double-encoded strings, very large strings (cap parse input at 1MB). Also add example snippet in README showing how to call NormalizeFunctionArgs before schema validation.
lina: for retries: change client behavior so that function-calling invocations include an invocation-id header (X-Invocation-Id) and we will not retry POSTs to user webhooks on transient auth errors unless the invocation-id is present and the webhook responds with 409 to indicate idempotent retry is allowed. Basically: don't blindly retry side-effecting calls.
tess: runtime change required: runtime should forward X-Invocation-Id to webhook and support idempotency lookup for 409 semantics. I'll open infra ticket INF-859.
noah: small UX ask: add sdk.go/helpers.ParseAndValidate(raw []byte, schema string) (parsed map[string]any, parseWarnings []string, err error) that returns warnings when we had to unescape or coerce types so app owners can surface helpful messages to customers during onboarding.
lina: +1. sample app should catch parseWarnings and log a single friendly message linking to our migration doc. many onboarding failures are just confusing stack traces.
tess: I'll gate the retry semantics behind a feature flag for 2 weeks and update ops for rollout. we must coordinate since this changes default retry behavior for function calls.
eng-bot: CI: go-sdk tests for branch go/json-normalize queued (6 jobs).
noah: I'll draft PR 4321 for Go SDK: NormalizeFunctionArgs, strictParse flag, parse warnings, and README updates. leaving TODO to add invocation-id header for function calls (depends on runtime INF-859).
lina: thanks. action items: noah -> PR 4321, tess -> runtime INF-859 + feature flag, lina -> update example app + onboarding note, ops -> coordinate rollout.
tess: recorded tracking ticket https://redwood.internal/issue/INF-859 with links to PR and repro. will update here when infra change is deployed.
lina: thanks team :raised_hands:
